items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: So I quit and joined the Buddy DeFranco Glenn Miller Orchestra. And we did a recording, “Live in London” at the Royal Festival Hall.

ctx.x: Because I had got a call to go — I’m moving this rocking chair — I got a call to go with the Glenn Miller band and they were going to Japan. Now here’s my ticket back. I said, “okay, I’ll go.” And we were going to London as well. So I quit and joined the Buddy DeFranco Glenn Miller Orchestra. And we did a recording, “Live in London” at the Royal Festival Hall. Now this was — I had never been this sick in my life. I was playing two bass drums then and endorsing Ludwig drums. Buddy DeFranco was a pretty serious…

open at 5 and by the time the job ends they were closed. I couldn’t get loaded, I couldn’t do anything. But I’m staying at the London Strand ghosting — we called it ghosting, you ever heard of ghosting?
